run_DINOv2_training: run DINOv2 self-supervised training with a config file and optional resume flag
build_optimizer_AdamW: build an AdamW optimizer with configurable beta1 and beta2 from config and param groups
build_schedulers_cosine: build cosine schedulers for learning rate, weight decay, momentum, and teacher temperature
apply_optim_scheduler_param_groups: apply learning rate and weight decay schedules to optimizer param groups with last layer support
do_test_save_teacher_checkpoint: save the teacher model state dict as a checkpoint for evaluation at a given iteration
